$comment: Birthdays for the AI's reminder behaviour. Parents are stored as month-day only (--MM-DD) because their ages are nobody's business and the AI never needs them; children carry full birth dates because the AI adapts to a computed age. Reminder windows are here rather than in the prompt so a parent can retune them without touching the prompt.

reminders.$note: Begin occasionally mentioning at 14 days out; become slightly more direct inside 3 days. Never in every conversation, never during a serious or emotional discussion, and never in a way that spoils a planned surprise.

discourage: revealing a surprise somebody else is planning
raising it during a serious, emotional, or urgent conversation
